name: Abundance
overview: Scripture reveals that abundance is a blessing from the LORD granted to those who diligently obey His commandments, as seen in Deuteronomy where God promises to exalt His people and open His good treasure to bless their work. The Psalms celebrate God's provision as overflowing and satisfying, describing a cup that runs over and a house filled with fatness, symbolizing richness and joy. True abundance also encompasses peace and goodness, gifts bestowed by God that bring delight and crown the year with favor.
